A home for my teaching material. Most subjects come in three layers: deep,
reproducible **reference notes**; curated **slide decks** that pick the key ideas for
a course; and runnable **labs**. Browse by **course**, by **topic**, or jump straight
to a **lecture or lab** below.

## Courses

Curated playlists — targeted slides, each backed by the full notes and labs.

- **[Probabilistic ML for Finance](courses/2025-finance-msc/index.qmd)** — Master's
  short course (10 h): measuring dependence, gaussianization, uncertainty, and fair
  learning, grounded in real market data.
